record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Song<WH07892> <FI>or<Fi> Psalm<WH04210>.<Fo><Fo> Make a joyful noise<WH07321><WTH8685> unto God<WH0430>, all ye lands<WH0776>: <RF>all...: Heb. all the earth<Rf>
Sing forth<WH02167><WTH8761> the honour<WH03519> of his name<WH08034>: make<WH07760><WTH8798> his praise<WH08416> glorious<WH03519>.

Say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto God<WH0430>, How terrible<WH03372><WTH8737> <FI>art thou in<Fi> thy works<WH04639>! through the greatness<WH07230> of thy power<WH05797> shall thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> submit<WH03584><WTH8762> themselves unto thee. <RF>submit...: or, yield feigned obedience: Heb. lie<Rf>
All the earth<WH0776> shall worship<WH07812><WTH8691> thee, and shall sing<WH02167><WTH8762> unto thee; they shall sing<WH02167><WTH8762> <FI>to<Fi> thy name<WH08034>. Selah<WH05542>.
Come<WH03212><WTH8798> and see<WH07200><WTH8798> the works<WH04659> of God<WH0430>: <FI>he is<Fi> terrible<WH03372><WTH8737> <FI>in his<Fi> doing<WH05949> toward the children<WH01121> of men<WH0120>.
He turned<WH02015><WTH8804> the sea<WH03220> into dry<WH03004> <FI>land<Fi> : they went<WH05674><WTH8799> through the flood<WH05104> on foot<WH07272>: there did we rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> in him.

He ruleth<WH04910><WTH8802> by his power<WH01369> for ever<WH05769>; his eyes<WH05869> behold<WH06822><WTH8799> the nations<WH01471>: let not the rebellious<WH05637><WTH8802> exalt<WH07311><WTH8799><WTH8675><WH07311><WTH8686> themselves. Selah<WH05542>.<CM>
O bless<WH01288><WTH8761> our God<WH0430>, ye people<WH05971>, and make the voice<WH06963> of his praise<WH08416> to be heard<WH08085><WTH8685>:
Which holdeth<WH07760><WTH8802> our soul<WH05315> in life<WH02416>, and suffereth<WH05414><WTH8804> not our feet<WH07272> to be moved<WH04132>. <RF>holdeth: Heb. putteth<Rf>
For thou, O God<WH0430>, hast proved<WH0974><WTH8804> us: thou hast tried<WH06884><WTH8804> us, as silver<WH03701> is tried<WH06884><WTH8800>.
Thou broughtest<WH0935><WTH8689> us into the net<WH04686>; thou laidst<WH07760><WTH8804> affliction<WH04157> upon our loins<WH04975>.

Thou hast caused men<WH0582> to ride<WH07392><WTH8689> over our heads<WH07218>; we went<WH0935><WTH8804> through fire<WH0784> and through water<WH04325>: but thou broughtest us out<WH03318><WTH8686> into a wealthy<WH07310> <FI>place<Fi> . <RF>wealthy: Heb. moist<Rf><CM>
I will go<WH0935><WTH8799> into thy house<WH01004> with burnt offerings<WH05930>: I will pay<WH07999><WTH8762> thee my vows<WH05088>,
Which my lips<WH08193> have uttered<WH06475><WTH8804>, and my mouth<WH06310> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>, when I was in trouble<WH06862>. <RF>uttered: Heb. opened<Rf>

I will offer<WH05927><WTH8686> unto thee burnt sacrifices<WH05930> of fatlings<WH04220>, with the incense<WH07004> of rams<WH0352>; I will offer<WH06213><WTH8799> bullocks<WH01241> with goats<WH06260>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>fatlings: Heb. marrow<Rf>
Come<WH03212><WTH8798> <FI>and<Fi> hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, all ye that fear<WH03373> God<WH0430>, and I will declare<WH05608><WTH8762> what he hath done<WH06213><WTH8804> for my soul<WH05315>.
I cried<WH07121><WTH8804> unto him with my mouth<WH06310>, and he was extolled<WH07311><WTH8785><WTH8676><WH07318><WTH8785> with<WH08478> my tongue<WH03956>.
If I regard<WH07200><WTH8804> iniquity<WH0205> in my heart<WH03820>, the Lord<WH0136> will not hear<WH08085><WTH8799> <FI>me<Fi> :
<FI> But<Fi> verily<WH0403> God<WH0430> hath heard<WH08085><WTH8804> <FI>me<Fi> ; he hath attended<WH07181><WTH8689> to the voice<WH06963> of my prayer<WH08605>.
Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> God<WH0430>, which hath not turned away<WH05493><WTH8689> my prayer<WH08605>, nor his mercy<WH02617> from me.<CM>
